data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: (a) Task scope clarification — closure assertion (dd5.json overall_result=true attached to epic 4047) is the SOLE pass/fail GREEN criterion. Runbook prose at plugins/dso/docs/runbooks/audit-live-runbook.md is best-effort documentation; runbook absence does NOT gate GREEN (runbook is a documentation deliverable, not a behavioral assertion). (b) Add contract-mock integration test AC: stub reconciler API to return a known pass+fail response payload; run full make audit-live pipeline; assert dd5.json overall_result matches expected derived value (true when all stubs pass, false when any stub fails). Validates that live-path data flows correctly through dd1→dd5 — not just unit-level fixtures.
